ErtObservationsRftResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a Ert rft observation export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

date.description: Index column. The date in ISO 8601 format this row represents. Required.
date.title: Date

east.description: The east coordinate this row represents. Required.
east.title: East

md.description: The measured depth along the well this row represents. Optional.
md.title: Md

north.description: The north coordinate this row represents. Required.
north.title: North

observation_error.description: The observation error in std this row represents. Required.
observation_error.title: Observation Error

observation_value.description: The observation value this row represents. Required.
observation_value.title: Observation Value

property.description:
Index column. The property this row represents, e.g. 'PRESSURE' or 'SWAT'. 
Required.
property.title: Property

response_key.description: Index column. The response key this row represents. Required.
response_key.title: Response Key

tvd.description: The depth coordinate this row represents. Required.
tvd.title: Tvd

well.description: Index column. The well this row represents. Required.
well.title: Well

zone.description: Index column. The zone this row represents. Optional.
zone.title: Zone

ErtObservationsRftResultRow.title: ErtObservationsRftResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant Ert rft observations parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: ErtObservationsRftResult
